mapper.update: UPDATE rx_dist_lock SET holder = NULL, expires_at = NULL WHERE lock_key = #{lockKey} AND holder = #{holder}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(collect_time) AS d, metric_name AS m, ROUND(AVG(metric_value), 1) AS avg, ROUND(MAX(metric_value), 1) AS max, ROUND(MIN(metric_value), 1) AS min, COUNT(*) AS samples FROM rx_metric WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND collect_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(collect_time), metric_name ORDER BY d ASC, m ASC

SELECT metric_name AS metricName, ROUND(AVG(metric_value), 1) AS avgValue, ROUND(MAX(metric_value), 1) AS `maxValue`, ROUND(MIN(metric_value), 1) AS minValue, COUNT(*) AS sampleCount FROM rx_metric WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND collect_time >= #{since} GROUP BY metric_name

SELECT DATE(collect_time) AS day, ROUND(AVG(metric_value), 1) AS avgValue, ROUND(MAX(metric_value), 1) AS `maxValue` FROM rx_metric WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND metric_name = 'DISK' AND collect_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(collect_time) ORDER BY day ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO rx_metric (instance_id, metric_type, metric_name, metric_value, collect_time) VALUES
(#{item.instanceId}, #{item.metricType}, #{item.metricName}, #{item.metricValue}, #{item.collectTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM rx_metric WHERE collect_time < #{cutoff} LIMIT #{limit}
